response: ["The licensed guideline corpus contains no recommendation for 'NEV'.","The router gated retrieval for 'MEL' (melanoma) was triggered because the checklist score met the melanoma suspicion threshold.","Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness.","Surgical excision is also the recommended first‑line treatment for melanoma in situ.","Surgical margins for excision should be based on tumor thickness.","Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor when indicated.","Sentinel lymph node biopsy should be performed in the same operative setting as wide excision whenever possible.","When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.","Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as those on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genitalia.","The recommendation for primary excision has a consensus rate of 100 % (21/21).","These guidelines support excision as the first‑line action when melanoma is suspected.","These guidelines align with the 7‑point checklist’s implication."]
